backend/main.mo: Main actor implementing a shop management system with user profiles, products, orders, recharges, bills, carts, and access control. Includes shop open/closed state (isShopOpen) with query and update functions for admins.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module defining OldActor and NewActor types with a run function that adds the isShopOpen field (defaulting to true) to the actor state during upgrades.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting five implemented features for shop status management: admin toggle switch, closed banner, disabled buttons, status indicator dot, and checkout popup notification.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components and pages, including shop status hooks, UI components with disabled states when closed, admin dashboard, and status indicators throughout the app.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for UI elements including primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, and sidebar styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with PWA meta tags, camera permission description, manifest link, Google Fonts (Inter), and mobile-optimized viewport settings for the Maa Bhawani General Store app.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA manifest defining app name, icons, theme colors, display mode (standalone), and orientation (portrait) for Maa Bhawani General Store progressive web app.
frontend/public/service-worker.js: Service worker implementing cache-first strategy for static assets and network-first for API calls, with install, activate, and fetch event handlers for offline functionality.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the application router using TanStack Router with routes for home, checkout, order confirmation, store details, admin dashboard, billing, and settings pages, all wrapped in a Layout component.
frontend/src/components/AdminGuard.tsx: Implements authentication guard for admin pages with hardcoded credentials, 24-hour session management, Internet Identity integration, and principal-based admin verification with fallback login dialog.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductForm: Provides a form for adding products with fields for name, category, price, unit type, barcode (with scanner integration), and image upload with progress tracking, including duplicate barcode validation.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductList: Displays a table of all products with images, details, and delete functionality using AlertDialog for confirmation, with loading skeletons and formatted unit types.
frontend/src/components/BarcodeScanner.t: Implements a barcode scanner component using Quagga2 library loaded from CDN, with camera access, flash toggle, haptic feedback, beep sounds, and scan cooldown to prevent duplicate reads.
frontend/src/components/BillHistoryTable: Displays a searchable table of all generated bills with view, print, and CSV export functionality, showing bill details like number, date, customer info, and total amount.
frontend/src/components/BillTemplate.tsx: React component that renders a printable bill/receipt template with shop header, bill details, itemized table, and total amount. Fetches shop slogan from backend and formats timestamps for display.
frontend/src/components/CallUsButton.tsx: Fixed floating button component in bottom-right corner that initiates a phone call to 9142876085 when clicked.
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: Side drawer component displaying shopping cart with item list, quantity controls, remove/clear actions, and checkout button. Includes weight/unit formatting helpers and shop open status validation.
frontend/src/components/CategoryFilter.t: Horizontal scrollable category filter bar with buttons to select product categories, highlighting the active selection.
Alert component displaying delivery policy information: free within 1km, ₹20/km beyond that.
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: React error boundary class component that catches rendering errors, displays error details with stack trace, and provides reset/home navigation options.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with three-column layout showing store info, contact details with phone/map links, delivery info, and copyright with caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header with store logo/name, shop open/closed indicator, cart button with item count badge, admin dashboard link, and login/logout authentication controls.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper component that composes Header, Footer, CallUsButton, and wraps page content in a centered container with consistent styling.
frontend/src/components/MobileRechargeSe: Form component for mobile recharge orders with banner image, inputs for mobile number (10-digit validation), operator selection, and amount, submitting to backend via mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/PaymentQRCode.ts: Displays a payment QR code card with the amount to pay, a static QR code image, and step-by-step UPI payment instructions including a contact number.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Renders a product card with image, category badges, price, and add-to-cart functionality; supports both unit-based and weight-based products with custom weight input parsing (kg/grams).
frontend/src/components/ProductGrid.tsx: Displays a grid of product cards with category filtering; shows loading skeletons while fetching and handles empty states.
frontend/src/components/ShopClosedBanner: Shows an alert banner when the shop is closed, informing users that orders are not being accepted and displaying the reopening time (8:00 AM).
frontend/src/components/ShopClosedChecko: Displays a modal dialog when the shop status changes from open to closed during checkout, redirecting users to the home page.
frontend/src/components/ShopStatusToggle: Admin component with a toggle switch to control shop open/closed status, displaying current status with a visual indicator and loading state.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, initializing access control with an admin token and invalidating dependent queries on actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for login/logout functionality, managing auth client creation, identity persistence, and authentication status throughout the app.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend operations including products, cart management, orders, order status updates, and shop status, using the actor from useActor and managing query invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Tailwind directives, defines CSS custom properties for light/dark theme colors using oklch color space (royal blue and emerald green palette), includes touch-friendly utilities, thermal printer styles for 80mm bills, and a barcode scanner laser line animation.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app with QueryClientProvider for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication context.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page with tabs for managing products, viewing order history, bills, and recharge orders. Includes order status management (pending → confirmed → packed → out for delivery → completed) with filtering and status update actions.
frontend/src/pages/AdminSettingsPage.tsx: Admin settings page for customizing shop slogan with a live preview of how it appears on bill templates using mock bill data.
frontend/src/pages/BillingPage.tsx: Point-of-sale billing interface supporting barcode scanning (camera or manual entry), building bill line items with quantity adjustments, customer details input, and bill generation with print functionality. Includes weight-based unit formatting for products.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Customer checkout page for placing orders with delivery details (name, phone, address, distance), dynamic delivery fee calculation, payment method selection (UPI/COD), and shop open status validation before order placement.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main landing page displaying store banner image, shop closed banner notification, mobile recharge section, and product grid for browsing available items.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Displays order confirmation details after checkout, showing order ID, payment method (UPI or COD), and conditional rendering of QR code for UPI payments or cash-on-delivery instructions. Retrieves order total and payment method from sessionStorage.
frontend/src/pages/StoreDetailsPage.tsx: Static page displaying store information including contact number, location with Google Maps embed, delivery policy, store hours, and available services for Maa Bhawani General Store & Banking Point.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support for maintaining state across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, extended theme with custom animations, typography, and container queries plugins.
project_state.json: Project state tracking document for MBG Store e-commerce system, documenting existing shop status toggle features and pending feature requests for admin-controlled shop open/close functionality with customer-facing status indicators.
